items.question: What is a Business Workflow Diagnosis — and how is it different?
items.answer: About 30 minutes to lock one revenue- or ops-critical workflow, clarify leaks, ownership, and next steps. Unlike report-only consultants, we can land and co-run so the team actually uses it.

items.question: How much time do I need — and what should I prepare?
items.answer: About 30 minutes. Bring your messiest line (e.g. WhatsApp sign-ups or quotes) and a concrete pain example. No polished deck required.

items.question: How are consulting fees calculated?
items.answer: By workflow complexity and scope — quoted after diagnosis. We don't push a system at the start.

items.question: What if we don't actually need AI or a CRM?
items.answer: I'll say so. Often the issue is unclear ownership and follow-up rhythm, not missing tools. Fixing the process may be enough.

items.question: Will our data and processes stay confidential?
items.answer: Yes. Operational details, customer data, and internal workflows shared in diagnosis or delivery are only used to serve you — never disclosed or published as a case without written consent.

page.whatBody: Dies ist ein Technologie-Prototyp / eine Demo für KI-basiertes Visual Tracking. Kein medizinisches Diagnosetool, kein zugelassenes Medizinprodukt und kein Ersatz für eine professionelle optometrische oder ophthalmologische Untersuchung. VisionXP ist ein zweisprachiges (Kantonesisch / Englisch) Trainings-Workflow-Demo für pädiatrisches Schielen und Amblyopie. Kinder von 3–12 absolvieren spielerische tägliche Einheiten von etwa 15–20 Minuten mit Pausen-Erinnerung. Eltern sehen Fortschritt, Serien und Erfolge. Optometristen sehen eine anonymisierte Patientenliste, Verordnungen, Compliance und Berichte. Die öffentliche Seite visionquest-web.vercel.app ist nur Frontend: kein Login, keine gespeicherten Patientendaten.

items.question: Are diagnosis and AI consulting the same track?
items.answer: Yes. Larry Lo / InnovateXP is the AI business consultant; diagnosis is the signature method before any land or co-run — not a SaaS pitch first.

items.question: How does SME workflow diagnosis work in Hong Kong?
items.answer: Book a diagnosis with your messiest line. We map ownership, handoffs, and tracking, then recommend next steps. Built for HK teams of 3–30 still running on manual follow-up.

items.question: WhatsApp and Excel are chaos — must we buy a CRM first?
items.answer: Not always. Diagnosis checks how current tools leak leads; if a clearer process is enough, you can wait on CRM.

items.question: Are training centres, tutoring, and fitness studios a fit?
items.answer: Yes. Common pain is class, attendance, renewals, or rostering stuck in WhatsApp/Excel. Diagnose ownership first, then decide on tools.

items.question: Will an SOP/automation advisor push AI immediately?
items.answer: No. Fix the process first; automate only when nodes are stable.

items.answer: Use “Book a 30-min diagnosis” to pick a slot, or ask on WhatsApp. We'll confirm industry, messiest workflow, and expected outcome.
